open_review.product_consistent: Product check: independent {provider} agreed on {instrument} within {deviation}% median deviation (n={bars} aligned bars, tolerance {tolerance}%) — same product class, not broker execution evidence.
open_review.product_divergent: Product check: independent {provider} disagrees on {instrument} (median {deviation}% > {tolerance}% tolerance, n={bars} bars) — the chart stays a source declaration; not broker execution evidence.
open_review.product_unverifiable: Product check: not available ({reason}); the instrument remains a source declaration, not broker execution evidence.

refresh.error: Refresh failed; the chart was not changed. Try again.

replay.boundary_note_open: Declared provider snapshot · not broker fills · R is a gross price move
